text:
lauren: Quick check-in: proposing a short X thread + 2 LinkedIn caption variants for the benchmark webinar next week. Need art + final copy by EOD so we can queue.
lauren: Goals: drive signups, capture utm tags, and have a pinned follow-up clip for replies.
diego: I'll make a 30s clip from the webinar highlights once we have slides. Will also export a 1200x675 screenshot for X.
kasey: Caption variants: A = data-first, B = engineer-story. Drafts below. react :thumbsup: to approve.
kasey: LI-A: "Production benchmarks: lower unit costs without trading latency. Join our webinar for a practical checklist. https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=apr_bench"
kasey: LI-B: "How an infra lead cut inference spend while keeping SLOs. We'll share configs and rollout tips. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=apr_bench"
micah: X thread draft (3 tweets): 1) headline stat + hook, 2) short method note + screenshot, 3) CTA with utm_source=x_thread&utm_medium=social_x. Put link in last tweet only.
diego: I'll upload assets to https://figma.com/file/bench_apr/export and add alt text: 'chart showing per-token cost across model variants'.
lauren: Scheduling: LI Thu 9:30am PT, X Thu 11am PT, reminder Wed 4pm PT. queue-bot can you schedule to Buffer?
queue-bot: queued -> Buffer. LI: 2024-04-18T16:30:00Z, X-thread: 2024-04-18T18:00:00Z, Reminder: 2024-04-17T23:00:00Z.
micah: Lead routing: HubSpot form should map utm_source to contact.source and add tag 'bench-apr-24'. Diego, can you ensure the link includes utm params before scheduling?
diego: yes will patch utm strings in the final link.
kasey: Follow-up plan: reply to the X thread with the 30s clip within 24h of webinar; 3 days later send LI message to registrants who didn't attend with recording. I'll draft DM copy.
lauren: tiny edit to LI-A: change 'practical checklist' to 'playbook' please.
kasey: done. LI-A updated.
lauren: please react :thumbsup: by 3pm if all good; otherwise flag changes. we'll push queue at 3:15pm. :rocket:
